chapter: Starting out and leading a band
title: White society jobs and the world convention band
summary: He describes the American Can and Acme Insurance jobs and the world convention, and the confidence playing alongside white bands gave him.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: them bands, man, you could let them, look at them in the stores there. Man, you worried about them, man, they come up here to make money. We

make them. We made it on that. Time around from that, they hired me. I played the world convention, I wish I had that picture to show you. I had a book of me. The whole village, I tell you who was playing with me. Boy was like Dr. Cleo, you remember Cleo, you played bass? Oh yeah. You played with Howard. I had Cleo, you remember Tato. Oh yeah. Point out playing with me. Alto. Alto, yeah. I had his brother on piano and had a boy that called Paul Antwine and Harmon Antwine. We played at the world convention. Tony Ambricko was downstead and we was upstairs. While we played, ma'am. Ma'am. If you want to stop anytime, go ahead. No, wait, I was in Valorant. In the finish time we leave there, we leave off the, new ferry boat, we go to New Orleans Airport and play it again. We played that night that day. So then boys, you know what people doing, I just wish I had the book to show you. You know what I'm doing? Cleo, man, they bought us everything. They took all kinds of pictures of us. Cleo was riding the bass. You know Cleo used to take and ride that bass and play it like that. And well, made it on that. I made it on that turnaround. I get another job, same company I work for, the Acme Insurance Company. I played at the Junk Hotel for them. Well, everywhere I went, they had white bands. And that's what gave me courage to bring me up on, not to be scared to play my horn with nobody. See? You got sellers that's playing, you know they see another band, they get scared. But I'm not scared of nobody. If a man's better than me, that's what I was thinking. You understand what I mean? I take it like that. If you better than me, I ain't gonna say nothing. Well, someday I might catch up with you. You understand what I mean? I might catch up with you. I don't say I'm no star. You understand what I mean? Well, I'm gonna do my part when I'm supposed to do. And right now the band I got. I got a band. I got a good set up of boys. I ain't got no youngsters. I'll tell you what I got. I use Bigfoot Billy. I use Charlie Anthony. Charlie Hamilton. Yeah, piano player. Play piano with me. I use Homer Lejean. He plays great guitar and trombone. When Clem is not playing at the Paradise, I use them on bass with me. That's the kind of band I'm doing. And don't you think them old man can't play? Them old man really plays some music. You understand what I mean? Sure. What I like about them, them young, them youngsters is alright. But they don't know nothing to beat them old man. See now, like we got a dance at the Auto Crack Out Club, the Lions Club. What we got down now, see they got a big 14 band, 14 piece band. All you can sign. See it's 14 piece of music.
